name: Grand Chamber
desc1: Flags of silk hang high above you in this massive chamber. The ceiling
desc2: easily reaches upwards of thirty feet, and the white stone gives the
desc3: passage an almost pristine quality. A carpet of royal purple has been
desc4: covers the floor, shimmering as if to honor your prescence.
desc5: A large glowing key floats in the center of the room, just out of
desc6: reach. On the far wall a wooden sign can be seen, a crude rusted nail
desc7: stabbed in the middle of it.
